title: Understanding Loss Functions
text: When considering loss functions, think about how they handle differences between predicted and actual values. A function that raises these differences to a higher power will generally penalize larger errors more severely. Consider how this might affect outliers.

title: Comparing Powers in Loss Functions
text: If you compare the Mean Squared Error (MSE) with a function that uses a higher power, such as cubing or raising to the fourth power, how does this change the impact of larger errors?

hintAnswer: Cubing increases the penalty for larger errors more than squaring does.
